title: Decide how far a candidate may safely advance
description: Change the evidence volume, tolerated regression, candidate behavior, and requested exposure. The gate uses uncertainty, critical slices, safety failures, and judge calibration instead of trusting one average score.

candidates.label: Broad improvement
candidates.detail: Quality and the critical slice improve with calibrated judging and bounded cost.

candidates.label: Average hides a weak slice
candidates.detail: The global score rises while a high-value cohort loses grounded answers.

candidates.label: Fast but weak evidence
candidates.detail: A favorable automated score comes with low judge agreement and higher safety uncertainty.

candidates.label: Quality with operational pressure
candidates.detail: Offline behavior improves, but latency and cost exceed their warning budgets.
